subject: general
question: In July 2021, who among the following became India’s first Union Minister of Cooperation?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Amit Shah.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Ministry of Cooperation:**

 
• Ministry of Cooperation was formed in **6th July, 2021.**
 
• The Ministry is **headed by Shri Amit Shah, Hon’ble Minister for Cooperation**
 
• **Shri B. L. Verma, Hon’ble Minister of State for Cooperation**.
 
• The **Ministry's administrative head is the Secretary of Cooperation**.
 
• **One Additional Secretary, two Joint Secretaries, and one Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies assist the Secretary of Cooperation.**
 
• The Ministry is **responsible for provide a separate administrative, legal and policy framework for strengthening the cooperative movement in country**.**​**
